purpose: Machine-readable spoiler-light campaign-library development updates for a future DungeonMasterOS Updates UI.

updates.headline: Campaign Library research begins
updates.summary: Source-verified campaign research has begun. Native rulesets, progression, source rights, locations, NPCs, factions, encounters, secrets and story outcomes are recorded before campaigns become playable AI-DM templates.

updates.headline: First campaign approved: Midnight in Bonetown
updates.summary: The first campaign passed source, licence, story-graph and adversarial AI-DM review. DungeonMasterOS tracks factions, threats, relics and changing world state without forcing a single route.

updates.headline: Second campaign approved: A Tomb of Twins
updates.summary: A Tomb of Twins passed full campaign-template review, including competing employers, trapped spirits, lich state, soul-vial custody, alternate outcomes and playable ghost-character continuity.

updates.headline: Gothic and sci-fi campaigns enter QA
updates.summary: The Old Blood and Leviathan now have campaign-state graphs. Final authoritative source-detail verification remains before approval.

updates.headline: Research expands beyond fantasy
updates.summary: Active research now includes gothic horror, vampire chronicles, science fiction, space horror and post-apocalyptic survival. Proprietary settings use metadata/private-import paths rather than redistributed protected story text.

updates.headline: Current focus: increase the completed campaign count
updates.summary: Completion now outranks raw discovery. Open, fully accessible campaigns are prioritised so exact locations, NPC behaviour, encounter logic, clocks, consequences and endings can be extracted and QA-tested.
